title: 3 dollarlik qo'g'irchoq birinchi yili qancha sotildi?

scenes.text: 1959 yil 9 martda Nyu-Yorkdagi o'yinchoqlar ko'rgazmasida 3 dollarlik yangi qo'g'irchoq chiqdi.
Uni Mattel asoschilaridan biri Rut Xendler o'ylab topgan. Qizi qog'oz qo'g'irchoqlarga kattalar rolini berib o'ynardi.
O'sha paytda qo'g'irchoqlar asosan go'dak qiyofasida edi. Kattalar qiyofasidagi qo'g'irchoqqa ko'pchilik ishonmadi.
Birinchi yilning o'zida 300-350 ming atrofida dona sotildi.
Qo'g'irchoqqa Xendlerning qizi Barbara nomi berildi. Uni bugun Barbi deb bilamiz.

description:
Barbi 1959 yil 9 martda Nyu-Yorkdagi Amerika xalqaro o'yinchoqlar ko'rgazmasida 3 dollarga taqdim etilgan. Uni Mattel hammuassisi Rut Xendler yaratgan va qizi Barbara sharafiga nomlagan. Birinchi yili 300-350 ming atrofida dona sotilgan.

Sizga kimning g'oyasiga hech kim ishonmagan, lekin u ishlagan? Izohda yozing.
source: Fact-checked 2026-11-23 (web-search summaries; pages did not open). TRUE: debut 9 March 1959 at the American International Toy Fair, New York; price $3; named after daughter Barbara; Ruth Handler co-founded Mattel. SOFTENED: first-year sales are reported as 350,000 by most outlets but 300,000 by Smithsonian, so the line now says 300-350 thousand. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Barbie ; https://www.smithsonianmag.com/arts-culture/cultural-history-barbie-180982115/ ; https://www.history.com/news/barbie-through-the-ages ; https://moneyweek.com/383146/9-march-1959-barbie-is-unveiled-to-the-american-public ; https://www.britannica.com/biography/Ruth-Handler
